about: The ramp FTP test from the library: warm-up skipped, the rider holds up to 230 W so the test ends itself (fail), cool-down, a stop right after the result (no auto pause for 30 s) and then an auto pause

workout.name: Ramp FTP test
workout.description: Zwift-style ramp: 1-minute steps from 100 W, +20 W every minute, with no top step. The test ends itself when you can't hold the target (or hold B), the coach gives you the result and the cool-down starts. FTP = 75% of your best minute, with a button on the summary to apply it.

messages.text: Ramp test today. Easy spin for the first 5 minutes.
Then 1-minute steps from 100 W, +20 W every minute.
Go until you truly can't hold the target. The test ends itself.
Your new FTP is 75% of your best minute.
Stay seated the whole way. Cadence 90 to 100.
Is the FR970 recording? Start it now if not.
Two more easy minutes. Breathe, loosen your grip.
